title: (6 ft) Commscope inc. F6SSVV Brightwire 9900963 (ETL)US CATV 18 AWG
categoryName: Consumer Electronics:TV, Video & Home Audio:TV, Video & Audio Accessories:TV & Video Accessories:Video Cables & Interconnects
descriptionText:
This Commscope Inc. cable is a great choice for your TV, video, and home audio needs. With a length of 6 ft and a gauge of 18 AWG, it provides a high-quality connection for your devices. The cable is black in color and features a PCT-DRS-60 connector on both ends.

This cable is made in the United States and is designed for use in consumer electronics, specifically for TV, video, and home audio accessories. Its one-to-eight connection split/duplication and ETL certification ensure that it is a reliable choice for your needs. Whether you're setting up a home entertainment system or running cables for your devices, this Commscope Inc. cable is a great choice.
